تفرعنت (form IIq)
# تَفَرْعَنْتُ (tafarʕantu) /ta.far.ʕan.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَفَرْعَنَ (tafarʕana)
# تَفَرْعَنْتَ (tafarʕanta) /ta.far.ʕan.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَفَرْعَنَ (tafarʕana)
# تَفَرْعَنْتِ (tafarʕanti) /ta.far.ʕan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَفَرْعَنَ (tafarʕana)
# تَفَرْعَنَتْ (tafarʕanat) /ta.far.ʕa.nat/: t
